caveats: Identity boundary: Chon Kwon Uk is the worker named in the MSMT Kyonghung IT case study and Annex 9. Lai We Wang and Zhong are source-reported labels only. The group-level laiwe GitHub handle is not attributed to Chon without a one-to-one source bridge.
Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; do not imply that the apparent alias owner is the DPRK worker.

Identity-document imagery is do-not-publish evidence only. Do not export, cache, crop, transcribe, OCR, reproduce, perform facial recognition or identity matching, resolve aliases, or infer current appearance or location; preserve citation provenance only.

The source also lists single-name alias labels for this individual: Zhong. They are kept out of the searchable name fields because a bare first name identifies nobody; see the sourced facts for their context.
Source-reported alias labels with no platform stated: laiwe. They are not shown as account handles; any live account using these strings is not attributed by the source.
Persona names shown here are labels reported by the cited publisher. They are not asserted to be anyone's legal name, and unrelated real people who share a name are not implicated.
'Zhong' is the display ID of a Telegram account MSMT lists as used by Chon Kwon Uk and now defunct; it is not a persona name.

MSMT attributes email accounts with the local part 'laiwe' to Chon Kwon Uk, but attributes the GitHub account 'laiwe' to Kyonghung IT workers collectively. The empty GitHub account of that name is not confirmed to be his and is not listed here.
Accounts and handles are historical observations reported by the cited sources. Present control of any account is not asserted, and a persona name is not asserted to be anyone's legal identity.
